document_record_signed_commit.name: document_record_signed_commit
document_record_signed_commit.value: "app"."document_record"."form_code" not in ('CERTIFICATION', 'SIGNED_FINAL_MANUSCRIPT') or "app"."document_record"."linked_commit_id" is not null

document_record_optional.name: document_record_optional
document_record_optional.value: not "app"."document_record"."optional" or ("app"."document_record"."form_code"::text in ('TDW_01', 'TDW_02', 'TDW_04') and "app"."document_record"."template_required_item_id" is null)

defense_attempt_verdict_set.name: defense_attempt_verdict_set
defense_attempt_verdict_set.value: ("app"."defense_attempt"."verdict" is null) = ("app"."defense_attempt"."verdict_by_user_id" is null) and ("app"."defense_attempt"."verdict" is null) = ("app"."defense_attempt"."verdict_at" is null)
